Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Taylors Falls for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, including the free Taylors Falls Lighting Festival and the free Afternoon with Santa at the 1855 Folsom House. The season opens November 27 with the Grand Lighting of the Village and Santa Parade on Bench Street at 6 pm, then Christmas at the Folsom House and Afternoon with Santa on December 6 from 1 to 3 pm. Storytime with Mrs. Claus at the library is November 27 from 5 to 6 pm. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Taylors Falls

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Taylors Falls
  • Free events: the Taylors Falls Lighting Festival and Afternoon with Santa at the Folsom House
  • Meet Santa: Schoony's courtyard after the November 27 parade, Storytime with Mrs. Claus, and Afternoon with Santa on December 6
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Grand Lighting of the Village and Santa Parade, November 27 at 6 pm
  • Trains: the Osceola and St. Croix Valley Railway departs from the 1916 SOO Line depot at 114 Depot Rd, Osceola, Wisconsin, across the river; we found no 2026 Christmas dates on a host page
  • Season: November 27 to December 6, 2026
